recipe.title: Gourmet Baked Heirloom Tomatoes with Dairy-Free Herbed Ricotta
recipe.description: Succulent ripe heirloom tomatoes filled with an artisan dairy-free cashew ricotta, finished with a golden panko crunch and vibrant basil pesto drizzle.

ingredients.item: Raw cashews (soaked in boiling water for 15 minutes)
Fine sea salt and black pepper

instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C) and lightly grease a small baking dish with olive oil.

Slice off the top quarter of each tomato. Gently scoop out the core and seeds using a spoon, leaving a sturdy 1/2-inch shell. Lightly salt the interiors and invert them onto paper towels to drain excess moisture for 10 minutes.

In a high-speed blender or food processor, combine the drained soaked cashews, nutritional yeast, lemon juice, minced garlic, 2 tablespoons of warm water, 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, and pepper. Process until completely smooth and velvety.
Transfer the cashew cheese to a bowl and fold in the chopped fresh basil and half of the dairy-free mozzarella shreds.
Spoon the herbed dairy-free cheese mixture evenly into the hollowed heirloom tomatoes. Top with the remaining dairy-free mozzarella, Panko breadcrumbs, and a drizzle of the remaining olive oil.
Bake in the preheated oven for 22 to 25 minutes, until the tomatoes are tender, the cheese is melted, and the breadcrumbs are golden-brown and crisp.
Garnish with toasted pine nuts and extra fresh basil before serving hot.

tips: Soaking the cashews in boiling water is essential for creating a smooth, creamy dairy-free ricotta texture without grit.
Choose firm yet ripe heirloom tomatoes so they hold their shape during baking.
